name: deploy
summary: Deploy and inspect remote hosts over SSH.
description: Provides the deploy (git pull, optional post-deploy command, remote oxidepm restart) and diff (remote git log, status and diff stat) commands over SSH. It has no daemon write access and writes nothing locally.

verbs.name: deploy
verbs.summary: Deploy to a remote server via SSH (pull, optional post command, restart).

verbs.name: diff
verbs.summary: Show recent commits and uncommitted changes on a remote server via SSH.
